tasks.title: THE ORIGINAL BATCH
tasks.prompt: How many badges were meant to be in the original batch, and where were they going?
tasks.explanation: Job J-170 is the original order: 12 finalist badges for the Registration Desk, approved by APR-170.
reference_sql: SELECT batch_id, quantity, destination FROM sql03_print_jobs WHERE job_id='J-170'

tasks.title: WHAT THE MANIFEST PROVES
tasks.prompt: What did the 14:46 route manifest actually prove?

options.text: A planned route was generated, not a physical handoff
The original batch passed a failed quality check

tasks.explanation: RM-17 is a PLANNED_ROUTE manifest generated from the plan; it is not a custody acceptance.
reference_sql: SELECT manifest_type,status,note FROM sql03_route_manifests WHERE manifest_id='RM-17'

tasks.title: DID KABIR ACCEPT THE BATCH
tasks.prompt: Which recorded event shows Kabir did not accept the original sealed batch?

options.text: The empty-tote scan at 14:49, combined with no B-17 custody acceptance

tasks.explanation: Kabir’s 14:49 scan is a TOTE_SCAN of an empty tote; no scan shows him accepting the sealed B-17 sleeve.
reference_sql: SELECT scan_id,event_at,scan_type,package_state FROM sql03_custody_scans WHERE batch_id='B-17' ORDER BY event_at

tasks.title: THE REPRINT APPROVAL
tasks.prompt: Why is the B-17R approval reference invalid?

options.text: APR-044 belongs to unrelated lanyard order L-04
The registration desk approved the reprint

tasks.explanation: Job J-171 cites APR-044, which belongs to lanyard order L-04 and is REJECTED for the reprint.
reference_sql: SELECT j.job_id,j.approval_ref,a.request_id,a.result,a.note FROM sql03_print_jobs j LEFT JOIN sql03_approval_audit a ON a.approval_ref=j.approval_ref WHERE j.job_id='J-171'

tasks.title: WHO HELD AND REQUESTED
tasks.prompt: Who initiated the replacement job and had the original in recorded custody immediately before the trail breaks?
tasks.explanation: Nisha scanned B-17 into the logistics cage at 14:44 and requested the J-171 reprint at 14:54.
reference_sql: SELECT j.requested_by,s.scanned_by,s.event_at,s.scan_type FROM sql03_print_jobs j JOIN sql03_custody_scans s ON s.batch_id='B-17' WHERE j.job_id='J-171' AND s.scan_type='CUSTODY_IN'

tasks.title: THE BEST EXPLANATION
tasks.prompt: Which explanation best fits the full record?

options.text: Nisha diverted the original while it was under her recorded custody, ordered an unapproved reprint, then tried to pass it off as the original to avoid disrupting the sponsor photo.
Kabir stole the original after accepting it at 14:46.
Aarav deliberately printed too few badges and hid the rest.
Leena received all 12 badges but miscounted them.

tasks.explanation: Nisha’s own messages ask for a hold, a reprint without approval, and for the replacement to be treated as the original, which her custody scans and the approval audit do not support.
reference_sql: SELECT m.sent_at,m.sender_id,m.message_text FROM sql03_messages m WHERE m.sender_id='NISHA' ORDER BY m.sent_at
